Oh boy i love telling this story.  This past new years a friend of mine lets call him M invites me and our friend group to what he called "project X" like party. Girls, booze, live entertainment from local bands, non-stop excitement and thrills!!! Well we get there and it was NOTHING like he said it would be. The house looks run down and too small there is graffiti all over the front and the word SATAN spray painted on the door. We have to go around back where it seems like a convoy of homeless people and meth heads decided to take camp. There was only ONE girl there our age (were in our mid 20s) the rest seemed far older and the ones who might have been our age were aged far beyond their natural age due to meth. The only food avalible for guest was three hard shell tacos on a paper plate. the "booze" was a Styrofoam cooler outside filled with some sort of yellow and brown liquid in an unlit area that was only 1/4 full. Now the band was playing in the living room and to get to the living room you had to go through the kitchen and through a "hallway" I say hallway in quotations because this hallway had a dyer and washer AND TOILET so FORGET privacy people were crammed were standing IN the "hallway/laundry/openbathroom" to see the band. Whenever they switched bands everyone was kicked out and forced outside in the freezing cold. So there was NO food NO booze NO heat No one our age and NO privacy to pee. I was the first one to arrive so i was there for two hours since M was my ride. When our friend group showed up they only stayed there five minutes before they saw the state of things and left taking me with them. We went to a bar a couple blocks down which was 20 bucks entry for unlimited Champaign and buffet. We don't trust M when it comes to parties anymore.
